name: github_issues
description: Golden cases for GitHub issue responses (plan §8.2)

cases.name: migration-lock-timeout
cases.input: Schema change hangs with a lock timeout on large tables.
cases.expected_output: Use the online schema change path; large backfills must set a higher statement timeout.

cases.name: pagination-blank-page
cases.input: Keyset pagination returns an empty page after the first fetch.
cases.expected_output: Order by the same unique key used for the cursor; mixed orderings break keyset pagination.
